title: Document
description: A document that has been uploaded to the Xceptor platform for intelligent data extraction and processing.

id.description: The unique identifier of the document

filename.description: The original filename of the uploaded document

content_type.description: The MIME type of the uploaded document

status.description: The current processing status of the document

classification.description: The document type classification determined by AI or assigned by template

template_id.description: The extraction template used for this document

confidence_score.description: The overall confidence score for the classification (0.0 to 1.0)

page_count.description: The number of pages in the document

uploaded_at.description: The date and time the document was uploaded

processed_at.description: The date and time extraction was completed

metadata.description: Custom metadata associated with the document
